A matched duet of Groove Tubes GT-6L6-C(HP) power vacuum tubes, specifically selected for guitar amplifier applications. Groove Tubes is industry-renowned for their rigorous "Performance Matched" testing process, which evaluates gain-to-distortion ratios to ensure consistent tone and harmonic richness across pairs.
Performance matched duet for balanced power amp operation
Medium (MED) output rating for versatile headroom and break-up characteristics
High-performance (HP) version of the classic 6L6 beam power pentode

This lot includes four petrified wood pieces weighing approximately 1 pound 6.4 ounces. Each piece measures between 3.25 and 5 inches. The specimens display natural wood grain texture with colors ranging from beige to brown. One piece has a polished end revealing internal structure, while others have rough, natural edges. Under UV light, the pieces exhibit fluorescence, highlighting their mineralized structure. All pieces are in natural condition with typical surface wear. Suitable for display, collecting, or educational use.
